integrity: A self-contained finite-state proof is given; finite code checks supplement rather than establish its infinite claims. No independent scientific audit is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Exact dyadic formula for exponents at least four; non-dyadic prefixes have a proved logarithmic error bound but no exact closed-form classification. Generalized Rudin–Shapiro words and the complete family of shortest absent subsequences are outside scope. Equivalent previously unindexed literature cannot be ruled out.
title: Dyadic subsequence universality of the Rudin–Shapiro word
